analysis.title: [GSX] The Momentum Reckoning Continues - Back to Sept Lows
key_insights: The GS High Beta Momentum Pair (GSPRHIMO) has erased all YTD gains after a 43% drawdown from its June peak of about +70%, as AI names re-rated lower.
Another leg lower in past winners (GSXUHMOM) came with a broad AI/Semis selloff, as the debate between AI costs and returns was reinforced by META's earnings.
AI Beneficiaries (GSTMTAIP) vs Top 500 ex AI (SPXXAI) had its worst relative day since Deepseek Monday.
GS continues to like the broadening trade: SPXXAI has outperformed the SPX by 6pp in October and is closing the gap vs SPX.
Correlation of AI (GSTMTAIP) with SPXXAI is falling. AI is about 50% of SPX and 45% of SPX names have negative beta to the index.
Momentum exposure is at its lowest since late June 2025 but still elevated at the 73rd percentile over 5 years.
Prime Services data show exposure to profitability at a 5-year high, visible in basket flows.
GS quality index GSP1QUAL (sector/industry/factor neutral) is up about 20% in 3m, driven by underperformance of the short leg (lower quality).
Historically it has worked to buy the dip in momentum. With cleaner positioning and an extreme drawdown, GS favors limited-loss structures for clients looking to buy the factor (pricing on request).
Momentum has recently traded the same way as AI Winners vs At Risk (GSPUARTI) and Semis vs Software (GSPUSOSE). GS expects this to change as momentum's composition rotates over the next few months.
AI themes remain the most exposed to momentum despite the selloff, and GS expects a rotation toward quality.
The pair is in its worst drawdown since the GFC, excluding the Covid period.

sector_views.rationale: Broad AI/Semis selloff, with AI themes still the most exposed to momentum and a rotation toward quality expected.
GS likes the broadening trade, with SPXXAI outperforming SPX by 6pp in October and closing the gap.
Clear 2H rotation toward quality, and Prime exposure to profitability is at a 5-year high.

earnings_insights: META's earnings reinforced the debate between AI costs and returns, per GS (no EPS or revenue figures given).

trade_ideas.description: Buy the momentum factor via limited-loss structures (GS desk to price), after the High Beta Momentum pair's drawdown
trade_ideas.rationale: Buying the dip in momentum has historically worked, positioning is cleaner and the drawdown is extreme versus history.
trade_ideas.risk: Historical instances include sharply negative forward returns, e.g. the 7/2/2026 instance showed -15.4% over 1m and -25.8% over 1y.

trade_ideas.description: Broadening trade: long the S&P 500 ex AI (SPXXAI) relative to the SPX
trade_ideas.rationale: SPXXAI is closing the gap vs SPX and AI correlation with SPXXAI is falling.

risk_factors: Continued AI/Semis selloff driven by the debate over AI costs versus returns.
Momentum is still elevated at the 73rd percentile of its 5-year history, so further de-risking is possible.
Past dips have not always rebounded, e.g. the 7/2/2026 and 1/20/2023 instances lost over 1m.
charts_described: Momentum has broken away from support levels and re-tested September lows (per the report's title and text).
Unconstrained Momentum (GSPRHIMO) is having its worst drawdown since the GFC, except for the Covid period (per the caption).
Prime Book is reducing exposure to Momentum while increasing exposure to Profitability (Prime Services data as of October 19, 2026).
vol_and_positioning: Factor positioning has rotated, with momentum exposure at its lowest since late June 2025 but still at the 73rd percentile over 5 years.
Prime Book is reducing momentum exposure and raising profitability exposure, with exposure to profitability at a 5-year high.
GS favors limited-loss structures to buy the momentum factor, citing cleaner positioning and an extreme drawdown (reach out for pricing).
After 1m drawdowns of 10% or more in GSPRHIMO, the median 1m forward return is +4.20% and the median 3m is +16.41%. The 1m hit rate is 61.54% and the 3m hit rate is 76.92%.

tension_points.bull_case: Buying dips in momentum has historically worked. The 3m median forward return after 10% 1m drawdowns is +16.41% with a 76.92% hit rate, and positioning is cleaner.
tension_points.bear_case: Momentum is still at the 73rd percentile of its 5-year range. The 7/2/2026 instance returned -15.4% over 1m, and the AI cost-versus-returns debate was reinforced by META's earnings.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Further AI/Semis weakness that keeps momentum trading in line with AI Winners vs At Risk (GSPUARTI) and Semis vs Software (GSPUSOSE), with no rotation in momentum's composition.
